source.method: Full-resolution raster (10367x7333px) viewed in zoomed sub-regions with a 25px reference grid overlay; plot numbers and unit-type colors read directly off the drawing. planPx values are raw source-image pixel coordinates.
source.coverage: Portofino: lagoon-front hero ring (BL101-159), western townhouse grid (BL178-424), southern boundary row (BL425-616), and northern entrance boundary row (BL162-177 + BL929-977) all digitized and verified. Eastern interior back-to-back column blocks (BL600s-900s interior rows) and a few small sub-clusters near the entrance (BL933-942, BL844-853, BL960s inner row) NOT yet digitized.

units.notes: Label partially occluded by adjacent shape on source raster; position interpolated between verified neighbours BL140 and BL142, plot existence/number not directly legible.
